description: This dataset contains observations of Cladium mariscoides, a species of sedge, collected from various locations in the United States and Canada. The data includes taxonomic information such as kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species, as well as spatial data like country code, state/province, decimal latitude, and decimal longitude. Temporal data includes event dates, days, months, and years. The dataset also provides details on the observers, identifiers, and licenses associated with each observation. The semantic profile indicates that the data is structured for biodiversity research, with columns serving as aggregation keys, spatial filters, temporal filters, and metadata. This dataset can be used for studying the distribution, habitat preferences, and temporal patterns of Cladium mariscoides, as well as for biodiversity monitoring and conservation efforts.
